title: Jubilant Silky Venezuelan Oats Empanadas
description: A festive Venezuelan dish featuring oats and a silky texture, made with a yeasty dough and a deglaze sauce, perfect for a snack or dessert. This recipe is nut-free-friendly, making it accessible to those with nut allergies.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine oats, flour, yeast, sugar, and salt.
Gradually add vegetable oil and water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle and place a tablespoon of melted butter in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg and bake for 20 minutes.
While the empanadas are baking, prepare the deglaze sauce by melting the brown sugar in a saucepan over low heat.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and brush them with the deglaze sauce.
